content: {"summary":"Customers report frequent delivery failures and delayed pickups, causing frustration and lost time [tk_2604182, tk_2683536]. Many complain about unauthorized charges and stock issues, leading to refunds that are slow or incomplete [tk_2945485, tk_2151044]. Returned items often arrive damaged or with the same defect, and replacement processes are cumbersome [tk_2855191, tk_2352234]. Additionally, account lockouts and communication gaps worsen the experience, leaving users unable to track orders or resolve issues [tk_52171, tk_136891]."}
